meta.title: ra9-atlas
meta.subtitle: Selected slices · A New Home → Stormy Night → Battle for Detroit (Kara) · The Hostage → Public Enemy · Shades of Color (partial chart) · The Painter (opening + leisure slice)
meta.disclaimer: Guide-based and screenshot-transcribed only. No transition is verified in game; game version and platform are unknown.

chapters.name: A New Home
chapters.code: D2 · selected Alice sequence + carried clues + second-floor events
chapters.desc: Selected local sequence transcribed from the Steam chapter screenshot, two guide-reported carried-state clues, and selected first- and second-floor events. Other chores and unresolved side links remain omitted.

coverage.scope: Selected local Alice sequence, two separate guide-reported gun/window clues, and selected guide-reported first- and second-floor events.
coverage.included: 35 events: 11 screenshot-transcribed events from WELCOME HOME through OPEN ALICE’S BOX; two gun/window clues; 10 additional guide-only first-floor events; and 12 second-floor events. The selected progressions are laundry to backyard to washer to Red Ice to Todd’s reported reaction, watch TV to blocking Todd’s view, Todd pills to the gun sighting, and Todd’s bed to Alice going to her room.
coverage.omitted: Other chores, unresolved screenshot side links, the differing guide order and unstated requirements among separate first- and second-floor tasks, Alice’s conversation choices, the exact relationship level for the key, how the gun clue is checked by the game, and window-escape outcomes.

chapters.name: Stormy Night
chapters.code: D2 · selected gun/window + non-gun escape routes
chapters.desc: Selected guide-reported entry sequence, gun/window events, and two distinct successful non-gun escape routes. Todd orders Kara to stay still, Alice runs upstairs, then Kara can obey and reach the fatal outcome (Todd kills Alice and Kara), or become deviant. The deviant alternatives go upstairs into the existing Reach Alice route or reason with Todd and stop at the reported point where Todd knocks Kara down and reaches Alice first. The corridor route hides until Todd passes and exits through the front door/backyard; the window route locks the room, goes out, passes the reported QTE and reaches the bus. The guides do not state Todd’s later state for either successful escape route, so both links to Todd not killed are explicit inferences. Other internal branches, the too-slow path, and other fatal or survival routes are not drawn.

coverage.scope: Selected entry gates, gun/window events, the existing Todd fate states, and two successful non-gun escape routes.
coverage.included: Twenty-four states/events: Todd not killed, Todd killed, take the nightstand gun, struggle for the gun, Kara shoots Todd, Alice shoots Todd, gun carried forward (Kara only), the window route opened from A New Home, nine steps/outcomes for the corridor and window escape routes, and seven entry-slice events/outcomes (Todd orders Kara to stay still, Alice runs upstairs, Kara becomes deviant, the fatal outcome, go upstairs, Reason with Todd, and Todd reaches Alice first). Twenty-four selected internal links.
coverage.omitted: The shared Todd-gets-mad scene as a separate box, the too-slow path, hidden timers, exact QTE requirements/difficulty, other fatal or survival routes, the later gun/fight/escape consequences of the Reason with Todd endpoint, miss-bus outcomes, and direct evidence of Todd’s later state after either successful non-gun escape.

chapters.name: Battle for Detroit — Kara
chapters.code: D2 · selected checkpoint + Todd meeting branches
chapters.desc: Guide-reported security-checkpoint detour timing branch and Todd meeting branch. The checkpoint route is not carried across chapters; the late-bus outcome still reaches the terminal. Ticket, border and river branches remain omitted.

coverage.scope: Selected checkpoint detour/timing branch and Todd meeting branch in Battle for Detroit — Kara.
coverage.included: Nine events: the checkpoint route choice, detour, delayed/last-bus outcome, bus-terminal arrival, Todd meeting, dialogue result, and two reported access gates.
coverage.omitted: Guarded-checkpoint interactions, ticket, border and river branches, downstream responses, and other checkpoint/timing cases.

chapters.name: The Hostage
chapters.code: D1 · visible chart transcription · saved-cop carry
chapters.desc: The visible Hostage chart is transcribed from one Steam “100% Chapter Flowcharts” screenshot: 33 boxes, 40 labels and 36 pictured connectors. An alternate selected-path chart resolves two readings and narrows one connector. The graph keeps 37 edge claims because the Friendly→FAIL candidate remains separate and uncertain; this does not add a confirmed pictured connector. GET CLOSE ENOUGH stays unresolved. The saved-cop option also has one guide-supported prerequisite into Public Enemy.

coverage.scope: Every box, visible label and connector in the single full Hostage chart screenshot, two readings checked against a separate selected-path chart, and one guide-supported saved-cop prerequisite into Public Enemy.
coverage.included: 33 boxes: 3 stage containers, 7 two-row choice groups (14 option labels), 16 action/flag boxes, 1 start and 6 endings. All 40 visible labels are present. The Steam chart shows 36 connectors. The map has 37 internal Hostage edge claims after one approach relation is split into uncertain Friendly and Cold candidates. It has 32 traced and 5 uncertain claims; the extra candidate is not counted as a confirmed pictured connector. GET CLOSE ENOUGH has no outgoing connector. One cross-chapter prerequisite leaves the SAVE WOUNDED COP option; LEAVE WOUNDED COP has no modeled consequence.
coverage.omitted: In-game verification; any branch set beyond this one screenshot; later Public Enemy cop rescue, death or other outcomes; consequences of meeting the saved cop; any outcome for LEAVE WOUNDED COP.

chapters.name: Public Enemy
chapters.desc: One bounded, guide-reported Public Enemy node: the cop saved during The Hostage can be met. The node records the meeting only. Later cop rescue or death outcomes and all other Public Enemy content are outside this slice.

coverage.scope: One saved-cop meeting node reached from the SAVE WOUNDED COP option in The Hostage.
coverage.included: One node, “Meet Cop From Hostage Situation”, and one incoming prerequisite gate. No outgoing consequence is drawn.
coverage.omitted: All other Public Enemy events and branches, every later cop rescue or death outcome, and anything that follows the meeting.

chapters.name: Shades of Color
chapters.desc: Twelve source-reviewed chart boxes and five continuously pictured connectors. coverage.scope: Twelve visible boxes and five continuous box-to-box connectors from the reviewed preparation packet.
coverage.included: One checkpoint, ten action/event boxes and one outcome. Main paint-store/package/bus chain, vendor-to-push and preacher-to-yells only.
coverage.omitted: Six detached segments from five icons have unknown source boxes. No invented checkpoint-to-side-event or protesters-to-bus edge, universal task order, exact harassment trigger, Painter consequence edge, platform/build or gameplay verification. Source-derived publication rights remain unresolved.

nodes.label: Todd orders Kara to stay still

PowerPyx lists Todd’s room (pills and magazines), Alice going to her room, toilet, bathroom, Alice’s room/window, then the floor and shelf books. PowerPyx also says Talk with Alice requires Todd’s room, the bathroom and Alice’s room plus reading the floor and shelf books; GameFAQs only says Alice’s room must be cleaned before Todd’s. These guide-specific orders and conditions are recorded as differing reports, not universal prerequisites or an AND gate.

a_enrage_todd.summary: Both guides report Todd reacting angrily after Kara finds the Red Ice during the laundry sequence.
a_enrage_todd.unknown: The guide-reported reaction is not verified in game and is not linked to later chapter states.

a_activate_vacuum.summary: PowerPyx and GameFAQs both report activating the vacuum robot during the first floor.
a_activate_vacuum.unknown: The reviewed guides do not establish this event’s order, requirements, or exclusivity.

a_take_out_trash.unknown: The different guide order does not establish a fixed sequence. Exclusivity and mandatory completion are also unstated.

a_tidy_pills.summary: Both guides report the pill bottle at Todd’s bedside. PowerPyx calls the step Tidy Pills and has Kara check the bottle; GameFAQs says to grab the bottle and then open the bedside-table drawer.
a_tidy_pills.unknown: The guides describe the handgun discovery differently: GameFAQs places it after the pill bottle, while PowerPyx has Kara check the nightstand directly. The reported sequence is not an eligibility requirement.

a_make_todd_bed.summary: Both guides report making Todd’s bed. PowerPyx places the automatic Alice move after this action; GameFAQs makes the bed last in Todd’s room.
a_make_todd_bed.unknown: The guides place the bed-making step differently within the room-cleaning walkthrough. No fixed order or requirement is inferred.

a_alice_goes_room.summary: Both guides report that Alice goes to her room after Todd’s bed is made.
a_alice_goes_room.unknown: The move is an automatic scene event, not a player task or a condition for later chapter access. The guides do not state what else may trigger it.

a_clean_toilet.summary: Both guides report cleaning the toilet on the second floor. PowerPyx places it before the bathroom; GameFAQs places it after Todd’s room.
a_clean_toilet.unknown: The different walkthrough positions do not establish a fixed order or a requirement for Talk with Alice.

a_arrange_bathroom_bottles.summary: Both guides report arranging or rearranging the bathroom bottles; PowerPyx specifies the bathtub.

a_mop_bathroom.unknown: PowerPyx lists cleaning the bathroom as one Talk with Alice prerequisite, but neither guide states that mopping is a separate gate. This is a guide-listed action, not a verified chart box.

a_read_putting_price.summary: PowerPyx names “Putting a Price” on the cupboard by Todd’s door and says to read both pages. GameFAQs reports one unnamed magazine in Todd’s room.
a_read_putting_price.unknown: The exact title is PowerPyx-only. GameFAQs does not establish a second magazine or a fixed reading order.

a_read_alice_shelf_books.summary: PowerPyx reports reading the books on Alice’s shelf between the bed and the door as part of the Talk with Alice requirement.
a_read_alice_shelf_books.unknown: GameFAQs does not describe shelf books in this section. Whether reading them is universally required is not established.

s_alive.summary: PowerPyx and Fandom both anchor the later Todd meeting on Todd not being killed in Stormy Night (PowerPyx: Todd can be “spared/avoided” in that chapter). The corridor and window escape routes now point here only as dashed inferences.
s_alive.unknown: The guides do not state Todd’s later state after either successful non-gun escape. Whether either route leaves him alive for the later meeting is unresolved; the two dashed links are not traced or confirmed.

s_dead.summary: Guides report that killing Todd closes the later Todd meeting branch. The selected Kara-shoots and Alice-shoots outcomes both feed this state; it has no outgoing connector.
s_dead.unknown: What the game checks exactly, and which other Stormy Night actions produce this state, are not covered by the reviewed evidence.

s_take_gun.summary: PowerPyx Stormy Night says that if the gun was found in Todd’s nightstand in Chapter 4, Kara can pick it up to threaten Todd and defend Alice.
s_take_gun.unknown: The exact underlying state check is not verified in game; finding the gun is distinguished from possessing it in A New Home.

s_gun_struggle.summary: PowerPyx describes Kara threatening Todd with the gun and a melee combat starting. The guide reports that a prompt can return the gun to Kara or leave it for Alice.
s_gun_struggle.unknown: Exact QTE timing, difficulty and moment-to-moment actions are not modelled.

s_kara_shoots_todd.summary: PowerPyx says that when prompted to pick up the gun again, doing so makes Kara shoot Todd. Its cross-chapter note says this approach gives Kara the gun for future chapters.
s_kara_shoots_todd.unknown: No later-chapter gun use is modelled, and the state is not verified in game.

s_alice_shoots_todd.summary: PowerPyx says that when prompted to pick up the gun again, not doing so lets Alice pick it up and shoot Todd. This is reported separately from the Kara-shoots outcome.
s_alice_shoots_todd.unknown: The guide does not give Alice’s shooting outcome a future gun-carry state; none is modelled.

s_gun_carried.summary: This node exists only to record the guide-stated future carry: PowerPyx says Kara having shot Todd gives Kara the gun in future chapters.

s_window_open.unknown: The exact QTE requirements, difficulty and hidden triggers are not stated. The guides also do not state Todd’s later state after this escape; the link to Todd not killed is a dashed inference.

s_reach_alice.summary: PowerPyx and Gamer Guides place the two non-gun routes after Kara goes upstairs and reaches Alice before Todd. This event starts both the corridor and locked-room branches.

s_run_away.unknown: Exact inputs and the timing window are not modelled.

s_front_backyard_escape.unknown: The guides do not state Todd’s later state, and the exact front-door/backyard QTE steps are not modelled. The dashed link to Todd not killed is an inference.

s_lock_room.unknown: The exact 10-second window and hidden checks are not modelled.

s_window_go_out.unknown: The guides do not state every prompt or hidden trigger involved before the climb.

s_window_qte.unknown: Exact prompt sequence, difficulty and hidden triggers are unresolved. The failing branch is deliberately omitted from this batch.

s_window_reach_bus.unknown: The guides do not state Todd’s later state, and the exact descent animations/inputs are not modelled. The dashed link to Todd not killed is an inference.
